result.summary: Local lint/build/test all pass. All 7 ACs plus the extra S6 CHECK case executed against a scratch Postgres with both migrations applied, all PASS with output matching expected. Real CI confirmed green for current HEAD 85db77003928af57dd87774273216d5f89e4ae57 (run 34030495026). MINOR finding (not a migration defect): the spec's literal psql command-tag counts were slightly off (10 ALTER TABLE not 9; CREATE INDEX is the real tag for both unique and non-unique indexes) -- a spec-authoring inaccuracy, every downstream AC independently re-verified the real schema regardless.

issues.description: docs/agents/test-specs/REQ-011.md's expected psql command-tag output for applying 0001_tired_annihilus.sql undercounts ALTER TABLE statements (says 9, real is 10) and doesn't note CREATE UNIQUE INDEX's tag is just CREATE INDEX. Cosmetic spec inaccuracy, not acted on since every substantive AC check independently passed against the real schema.
